import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 50;
    static final int M = 50;
    static final int K = 50;
    static final int T = N + K + 1;
    static final int N_ = N * T + 1;
    static final int M_ = K + (M * 2 * K + N) * (T - 1);
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static class Node {
        Node next;
        int dest;

        Node() {
            next = null;
            dest = 0;
        }
    }

    static Node[] aa = new Node[N];
    static Node[] aa_ = new Node[N_];
    static Node[] edgePool1 = new Node[1];
    static Node[] edgePool2 = new Node[1];

    static int[] pi = new int[N_];
    static int[] kk = new int[N_];
    static int[] bb = new int[N_];
    static int[] pq = new int[1 + N_];
    static int[] iq = new int[N_];
    static int cnt;

    static boolean LT(int u, int v) {
        return pi[u] < pi[v] || (pi[u] == pi[v] && kk[u] < kk[v]);
    }

    static int i2(int i) {
        i *= 2;
        return i > cnt ? 0 : (i < cnt && LT(pq[i + 1], pq[i]) ? i + 1 : i);
    }

    static void pq_up(int u) {
        for (int i = iq[u], j; (j = i / 2) != 0 && LT(u, pq[j]); i = j) {
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j];
        }
        pq[iq[u] = (int)(iq[u])] = u;
    }

    static void pq_dn(int u) {
        for (int i = iq[u], j; (j = i2(i)) != 0 && LT(pq[j], u); i = j) {
            pq[iq[pq[j]] = i] = pq[j];
        }
        pq[iq[u] = (int)(iq[u])] = u;
    }

    static void pq_add(int u) {
        iq[u] = ++cnt;
        pq_up(u);
    }

    static int pq_remove_first() {
        int u = pq[1], v = pq[cnt--];
        iq[v] = 1;
        pq_dn(v);
        return u;
    }

    static void add(int i, int j) {
        if (edgePool1[0] == null) {
            edgePool1[0] = new Node[M * 2 + 1];
            edgePool1[0] = edgePool1[0].next;
        }
        edgePool1[0].dest = j;
        edgePool1[0].next = aa[i].next;
        aa[i].next = edgePool1[0];
        edgePool1[0] = edgePool1[0].next;
    }

    static void add_(int i, int h) {
        if (edgePool2[0] == null) {
            edgePool2[0] = new Node[M_ * 2 + 1];
            edgePool2[0] = edgePool2[0].next;
        }
        edgePool2[0].dest = h;
        edgePool2[0].next = aa_[i].next;
        aa_[i].next = edgePool2[0];
        edgePool2[0] = edgePool2[0].next;
    }

    static int n_, m_;
    static int[] uu = new int[M_];
    static int[] vv = new int[M_];
    static int[] uv = new int[M_];
    static int[] cost = new int[M_];
    static int[] cost_ = new int[M_];
    static int[] cc = new int[M_ * 2];

    static void link(int u, int v, int cap, int cos) {
        int h = m_++;
        uu[h] = u;
        vv[h] = v;
        uv[h] = u ^ v;
        cost[h] = cos;
        cc[h << 1 ^ 0] = cap;
        add_(u, h << 1 ^ 0);
        add_(v, h << 1 ^ 1);
    }

    static void dijkstra(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(pi, INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        pq_add(s);
        while (cnt != 0) {
            Node l;
            int u = pq_remove_first(), v;
            int h, h_, p, k = kk[u] + 1;
            for (l = aa_[u].next; l != null; l = l.next) {
                if (cc[h_ = l.dest] != 0) {
                    h = h_ >> 1;
                    p = pi[u] + ((h_ & 1) == 0 ? cost_[h] : -cost_[h]);
                    v = u ^ uv[h];
                    if (pi[v] == INF) {
                        pi[v] = p;
                        kk[v] = k;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        pq_add(v);
                    } else if (pi[v] > p || (pi[v] == p && kk[v] > k)) {
                        pi[v] = p;
                        kk[v] = k;
                        bb[v] = h_;
                        pq_up(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void push(int s, int t) {
        int u, h, h_;
        for (u = t; u != s; u ^= uv[h]) {
            h = (h_ = bb[u]) >> 1;
            cc[h_]--;
            cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
        }
    }

    static int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        int c, h;
        System.arraycopy(cost, 0, cost_, 0, m_);
        while (true) {
            dijkstra(s);
            if (pi[t] == INF) break;
            push(s, t);
            for (h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
                int u = uu[h], v = vv[h];
                if (pi[u] != INF && pi[v] != INF)
                    cost_[h] += pi[u] - pi[v];
            }
        }
        c = 0;
        for (h = 0; h < m_; h++)
            c += cost[h] * cc[h << 1 ^ 1];
        return c;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int[] ii = new int[K];
        int n, m, k, t, c, d, h, i, j, s, u, v, x;
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        m = scanner.nextInt();
        k = scanner.nextInt();
        c = scanner.nextInt();
        d = scanner.nextInt();
        for (h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            ii[h] = scanner.nextInt();
            ii[h]--;
        }
        for (h = 0; h < N; h++) aa[h] = new Node();
        for (h = 0; h < N_; h++) aa_[h] = new Node();
        while (m-- > 0) {
            i = scanner.nextInt();
            j = scanner.nextInt();
            i--; j--;
            add(i, j); add(j, i);
        }
        t = n + k + 1;
        n_ = n * t + 1;
        m_ = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                Node l;
                u = i * t + s;
                for (l = aa[i].next; l != null; l = l.next) {
                    j = l.dest;
                    v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (x = 1; x <= k; x++)
                        link(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                u = i * t + s; v = u + 1;
                link(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        for (h = 0; h < k; h++)
            link(n_ - 1, ii[h] * t + 0, 1, 0);
        System.out.println(edmonds_karp(n_ - 1, 0 * t + t - 1));
    }
}
